technical-summary: Added wait_for_function and wait_for_selector methods to the CDP client, using puppeteer's event-based waitForFunction/waitForSelector instead of polling. Python side: new wait_for_function() on CdpClient with predicate_js and timeout_ms params. Node.js side: two new handlers in gpt_auto_cdp.cjs routing through page.waitForFunction/waitForSelector. This is the infrastructure that subsequent navigation commits depend on.
user-summary-candidate: CDP client gains event-based waitForFunction/waitForSelector methods — no more sleep-polling for DOM conditions.

technical-summary: Replaced all time.sleep polling loops with event-based wait_for_function calls for: workspace navigation (find_workspace, ensure_workspace), conversation resume (session_transport), ChatGPT ready check and login wait (prompt_injector). Each path retains the original polling loop as a fallback when the event-based wait times out. This eliminates unnecessary 10-20s sleep waits when the DOM condition is met early.
user-summary-candidate: GPT Auto navigation: replaced sleep-polling with event-based waits for workspace, conversation, and ready-state checks — each retains polling fallback.

technical-summary: Added _evaluate_resilient() helper that retries client.evaluate() up to 5 times with 0.5s backoff when a 'detached' execution context error occurs (ChatGPT navigation mid-turn). Replaced direct client.evaluate() calls in get_response_text(), _get_response_state() and is_generating() with the resilient wrapper. This prevents normal page navigations from crashing the caller's polling loop.
user-summary-candidate: GPT Auto DOM reader: retry on detached execution context when ChatGPT navigates mid-turn — prevents normal navigation from crashing the polling loop.

technical-summary: Added CDP test suite: event wiring tests (test_cdp_event_wiring.py, test_cdp_prompt_flow.py), code snippet extraction (test_cdp_code_snippets.py), demo scenarios (test_demo_live.py, test_demo_plan_review.py), event timing comparison (test_event_timing_comparison.py), and JS helpers for mutation observer/wait_for_function/wait_for_selector/wait_for_url. Debug scripts for workspace click, projects, tabs, and DOM inspection.
user-summary-candidate: GPT Auto CDP test suite: event wiring, code snippets, demo scenarios, and debug scripts.
